input: Set up a weekly cash withdrawal budget envelope

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which spending categories get envelopes determines how many envelopes to create and how complex the system needs to be.
The total weekly withdrawal amount is the single most important number that shapes every envelope allocation.
Whether this is for one person or a household affects how envelopes are divided, labeled, and accessed.
Whether they are starting from scratch or converting from an existing digital/card-based budget changes what setup steps are needed.
The physical format — actual paper envelopes, a wallet insert, a binder, or a digital tracker alongside the cash — determines the materials and tools required.
How strictly they want to follow the envelope rules (e.g., rollover unspent cash, strict no-overspend, or flexible) shapes the system's rules and reset process.
Knowing what problem they most want to solve — overspending, visibility, saving, or habit-building — determines what 'done well' looks like and how to measure it.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a weekly cash envelope budget system
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to create a structured weekly cash withdrawal and envelope budgeting system to manage their spending in physical cash categories.

questions.title: Which spending categories will have their own envelope?
questions.description: Identify the specific budget categories the user wants to manage with cash envelopes (e.g., groceries, dining, entertainment, transport).

questions.title: What is your total weekly cash withdrawal amount?
questions.description: Establish the fixed dollar amount the user plans to withdraw each week as the foundation for all envelope allocations.

questions.title: Is this budget just for you or a shared household?
questions.description: Determine whether one person or multiple people will draw from and manage the envelopes each week.

questions.title: Are you starting fresh or moving from an existing budget?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is building this system from zero or transitioning from a digital, app-based, or card-only spending method.

questions.title: What physical format will you use for the envelopes?
questions.description: Decide on the container system — paper envelopes, a labeled wallet, a cash binder, or a hybrid with a digital tracking companion.

questions.title: Should unspent cash roll over or reset each week?
questions.description: Define the rule for leftover money at the end of each week — whether it carries forward, moves to savings, or is zeroed out.

questions.title: What is the main problem this system needs to solve for you?
questions.description: Identify the user's primary motivation — stopping overspending, gaining spending visibility, building a savings habit, or reducing card reliance.
